svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 09 · San Francisco · 01/12 Parnassus Heights (Legendary)
svg.desc: Buildings stacked up a steep hillside, with the big tower on the ridge above, half in the fog. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
